text:
Which statement about a reaction in equilibrium is correct?
A
Both the forward and the backward reactions are proceeding at the same rate.
B
Neither the forward nor the backward reaction is proceeding.
C
The amount of product present is no longer affected by changes in temperature or pressure.
D
The amount of product present is only affected by a change in pressure.

options.label: A
options.text: Both the forward and the backward reactions are proceeding at the same rate.

options.label: B
options.text: Neither the forward nor the backward reaction is proceeding.

options.label: C
options.text: The amount of product present is no longer affected by changes in temperature or pressure.
